recordings.title: 1953 Studebaker-Starts, Rev and Idle
recordings.author: lonemonk
recordings.modifications: Excerpted from the publicly linked HQ MP3 preview; downmixed to mono, resampled to 48 kHz, high-pass filtered at 28 Hz, low-pass filtered at 6 kHz, DC removed, RMS normalized to 0.37 with soft peak compression only above 0.78 full scale (ceiling 0.93), exported as PCM16 WAV. Playback uses a 60 ms overlap crossfade and keeps original playback speed with vehicle-speed-dependent volume.
recordings.modifications_ko: 공개 HQ MP3에서 6초 발췌, 모노·48 kHz 변환, 28 Hz 아래와 6 kHz 위를 완만하게 감쇠, DC 제거, RMS 0.37로 음량 정리 및 높은 피크만 부드럽게 압축, PCM16 WAV 저장. 재생 시 60 ms 교차 페이드와 원래 재생속도 유지 및 차량 속도에 따른 음량 변화 적용.
recordings.acquisition: Public HQ MP3 preview; not the original WAV/FLAC master.
